title: Mechanical design Engineer (Data center)
description:
Hiring: Senior MEP Design Engineer – Data Centre Projects \*\*Company: Conserve Solutions

Location:\*\* Trichy, Tamil Nadu

Experience:\*\* 5–10 Years

Job Description We are looking for an experienced Senior MEP Design Engineer to handle data centre projects involving HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems.

Candidates should have knowledge of mission-critical infrastructure, BIM coordination, and software tools such as Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD.

Data centre project experience of at least 1 year is preferred.

\*\*Interested candidates:\*\* Apply through Indeed with your updated resume.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
